answer_2.quote: We quantify the visual text generation quality from two aspects: (1) CLIP score measures the semantic relevance between the generated image and the input prompt ... (2) OCR Accuracy detects the texts in the generated images utilizing OCR tools. ... we also evaluate the model's fundamental capability through FID score...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation comparing our English models with other baseline models on ChineseDrawText benchmark. Three raters are asked to compare these images from four dimensions including text aesthetics, text accuracy, semantic relevance, and image aesthetics, and then select the images they prefer.
answer_4.guideline: Raters compare generated images pairwise and select the preferred one based on four criteria: text aesthetics, text accuracy, semantic relevance, and image aesthetics.
